visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera opens with a wide-angle, high-perspective view overlooking a massive, undulating sea of bright white clouds that fills the valley floor and extends toward the distant horizon under a clear, pale blue sky. In the bottom right foreground, the steep, dark, crumbly terrain of a volcanic mountain slope is clearly visible, composed of jagged grey and black rocks with no vegetation. (2) A tight close-up shot focuses on the hands of an unseen person wearing a blue sleeve, carefully wrapping white medical bandage tape around another individual's swollen ankle. The injured leg is positioned on top of a weathered grey backpack that has the text "GALENA PACK 25" printed on its mesh, while a traditional Japanese wooden pilgrimage tag hangs nearby. (3) Three male hikers are filmed from a rear perspective as they slowly trek down a steep, loose-gravel mountain path towards the cloud line. The central hiker is visibly struggling and leaning on the shoulders of his two companions who are physically supporting his weight to prevent him from falling on the unstable volcanic soil. One hiker carries a wooden staff adorned with a small red flag. (4) The scene transitions to a static side-profile shot of a heavy-duty yellow industrial tracked carrier vehicle with the "YANMAR" brand name displayed prominently in black lettering on its chassis. The vehicle's large black metal treads are stationary, resting on the dark, dusty ground of the mountain, indicating it is prepared for transport or rescue duty. (5) A first-person point-of-view shot is taken from the rear flatbed of the tracked carrier as it moves slowly down the mountain. In the immediate foreground, a person's leg clad in grey trousers and a sturdy brown hiking boot is resting on the metal frame. Behind them, the rocky trail snakes upward, and the vast white cloud sea dominates the background. (6) A medium close-up shows a man with dark-rimmed glasses and a black hooded jacket lying flat on his back within the bed of the carrier vehicle. His face is oriented toward the sky with a weary and stoic expression, suggesting he is resting during his evacuation from the high-altitude site after suffering the injury. (7) The final frame of the sequence is a still image displaying a medical X-ray of a human ankle joint in a frontal view. The white skeletal structures of the tibia and fibula are clearly defined against the dark background, highlighting the internal bone alignment where the injury occurred, with a small yellow letter 'F' appearing as a marker.
